title: Proper-score observation-driven filters: local geometry, estimation, and continuous-time limits
summary: Observation-driven filters typically use likelihood-score updates, corresponding to the logarithmic scoring rule. We generalise these updates to negative parameter derivatives of differentiable proper scoring rules, under a declared working family and predictable scaling. The rule determines the conditional risk projection and tail response, scaling converts its derivative into the update, and the autoregressive component determines the composite dynamic centre.
